title: File access built from input (elixir) — review required
description: A elixir file operation builds its path from input: File.read!?s*([^)]*<>. Traversal sequences escape the directory. This lexical rule flags the construction; the reviewer confirms confinement via Path.expand plus prefix check.
remediation: Confine with Path.expand plus prefix check or map input through an allowlist.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any input-built path matches.
